# ImageKit.io

> > ImageKit.io is a real-time image and video API platform with AI-powered Digital Asset Management for optimizing media delivery at scale.

ImageKit provides comprehensive media optimization, transformation, and delivery solutions for web and mobile applications. The platform combines a powerful API for images and videos with an AI-driven DAM system, SDKs for popular frameworks, and features like automatic optimization for Core Web Vitals, adaptive video streaming, and AI-powered transformations.

## Key Topics

- Image Optimization
- Video Optimization
- Digital Asset Management (DAM)
- Image API
- Video API
- Image Transformation
- Real-time Processing
- CDN & Edge Delivery
- Responsive Images
- AI Transformations
- File Upload
- Core Web Vitals
- TypeScript Support
- Next.js Integration
- Video Streaming
